metadata.method: static inspection of selected source files; reference application not built or run

rules.source_observation: Permission enum: Guest=0, SendDoctor=1, TestDoctor=2, CheckDoctor=3, Engineer=4, Administrator=5.

Designer combo defaults are 检验医生/审核医生/工程师. Constructor does not invoke slotUserChanged. Runtime slotUserChanged clears and rebuilds both combos: role0 none; role1 送检医师; role2 送检医师/检验医师; role3 adds 审核医师; role4 and role5 add 工程师. The exact runtime labels use 医师, not designer 医生.
rules.migration_caution: Fixture role text must match runtime lookup; do not copy a production role database.

rules.source_observation: After role rebuilding Add remains first option when nonempty. Update is set to permission-1. Thus role1/2/3/4 select index0/1/2/3. Administrator5 requests index4 in a four-item combo; Guest0 requests -1 in an empty combo.
rules.migration_caution: Administrator update is an out-of-range-index source ambiguity. Verify Qt5 currentIndex/currentText at runtime; do not silently clamp to Engineer or invent an Administrator option.

rules.source_observation: Guest hides the account table and returns before clearing old cells. For permissions1..4 the nested predicate hides all records with role>=4. Administrator5 hides records role>=5 and can see Engineer4. Lower roles are not filtered against the current role: SendDoctor can see TestDoctor/CheckDoctor.
rules.migration_caution: Preserve exact source predicate rather than applying a generic role<=current filter. Hidden guest cells are not proof that old sensitive view data were cleared.

rules.source_observation: Table is read-only, no selection, no focus, ScrollPerPixel; rows are 41px high. A cellDoubleClicked connection is made within every displayed-row iteration on each refresh.
rules.migration_caution: Multiple accumulated connects are an implementation defect candidate; one equivalent connection may be used only with documented no-business-behavior change and regression.

rules.source_observation: Double-click copies the last-column username into ldtUserNameAdd, ldtUserNameDel, ldtUserNameUpdate and ldtUserNameUpdate2. It does not alter passwords or role combos. Entering the change tab forces both update username fields readOnly and resets both to the current session name and current role index. A subsequent double-click still calls setText and can replace those readOnly names.
rules.migration_caution: Do not assume update is limited to the current user or synchronize target role without source evidence.

rules.source_observation: Add validation order: Guest rejection; username OR confirmation-password empty rejection; password mismatch rejection; combo index==Administrator-1 rejection; role lookup by selected text; duplicate username rejection; insert id-auto/name/role/pwd/isdefault=0.
rules.migration_caution: Administrator option is not normally present, making index4 guard unreachable through normal role UI. Do not add a different permission model.

rules.source_observation: Add failure keeps fields; success shows 保存成功 then clears both passwords and username, selects Add index0 and refreshes list.

Delete always asks 确认删除用户？ before any validation. Any answer other than QMessageBox::Yes returns without database change. Then deleting the current session user while actionReady==false is rejected before existence/password checks.

Delete validation after confirmation/busy: target exists; target stored pwd equals entered target password; reject if current permission<target role; reject target role==Administrator. The equality/role checks do not have a separate Guest branch. The source permits deletion of other same-role accounts with known target password.
rules.migration_caution: Keep rejection order and target-password semantics. SQL query failures must no longer masquerade as nonexistent account; improved error reporting is an explicit migration difference.

rules.source_observation: Delete database failure keeps fields/no logout. Success shows 删除成功; if deleted name equals current session name emit signalLoginOut; then clears delete name/password and refreshes.

Update busy predicate rejects when combo.currentIndex()==permission-1 AND actionReady==false. This is equality, despite the comment saying changing user type while running is forbidden. Changed index can bypass this particular source check.
rules.migration_caution: Do not invert equality to inequality without a separately authorized behavior fix; test both same-role and changed-role running states.

rules.source_observation: Update order after busy: find old username; verify target old password; verify two new passwords equal; require new username nonempty. New-password empty check is commented out, so two empty new-password fields pass. No duplicate-new-name check and no current-role-vs-target-role check exist in this slot.
rules.migration_caution: These are source security/behavior ambiguities, not a recommendation for production policy. Preserve only within explicit anonymous offline scope and mark production login/security review pending.

rules.source_observation: Update obtains roleId by current combo text, writes old record id/new username/new pwd/new role/old isdefault; DB failure returns. Success shows 更新成功, clears all three update password fields, always emits signalLoginOut, then refreshes.
rules.migration_caution: Do not reset isdefault or forget logout. Empty/unmatched role text resolves to0 in UserRoleTable; invalid Administrator combo must be observable, not silently normalized.

rules.source_observation: user_information schema is id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name VARCHAR, role INTEGER, pwd VARCHAR, isdefault INTEGER. There is no UNIQUE(name) declaration. user_role is id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, role VARCHAR. getIdByRole returns0 on not-found or prepare error; getRoleById returns empty on failure.
rules.migration_caution: Use a new tagged anonymous database. Parameter binding/transactions/thread ownership/error separation can improve storage reliability while preserving normal field semantics.

rules.source_observation: The username validator config is Head_Letter_Num with lenght=16 for all four username edits. Actual regex is ^[A-Za-z0-9].{16}$, which has17 total characters for an Acceptable full match, while tooltip claims16. Intermediate validator states may still be present when a button handler reads text; handler does not call hasAcceptableInput().
rules.migration_caution: Do not rewrite to a conventional1..16 validator silently. Programmatic setText is different from actual typing and does not prove keyboard validation equivalence.

rules.source_observation: Original account signalLoginOut is connected to main on_btnLoginOut_clicked. That resets permission/name to Guest, emits signalLogout then opens login. Original login success notifies multiple pages; login showLoadInformation may send query reagent and deferred check-config signals.
rules.migration_caution: Offline slice must clear its explicit session and stop. Do not wire the full main/login/instrument chain.

rules.source_observation: UserPower::canDoPower scans user_powers.can_role_id split on semicolons and matches current numeric role. No such general capability lookup is called inside frmAccountSetting; this slice must not invent a replacement user_powers fixture or derive all permissions from rank.

Original default-account lookup and authentication live in UserInformationTable. Login empty password enters defaultPermission/Guest before confirmUserInfo; nonempty login consults name/password and may update isdefault for roles<=Engineer.
rules.migration_caution: Complete login/default-account/security behavior is outside O02-1. Never auto-create a default Administrator or infer original credentials.

source_defect_policy: Keep source-backed behavior within the anonymous offline slice; every intentional change is separately described. Static findings do not validate original runtime, production security, RK or instruments.
credential_evidence_policy: Only transient test secrets in mutable temp runtime DB; no passwords, password hashes, reversible secrets, or authentication DB files in formal evidence/screenshots/logs.

predictable_outcomes.observation: Current main scenario arithmetic is coherent:5 seeded accounts, temporary accounts removed, lockRetry plus retained account remain =>7 rows; role<4 visible rows expected5.

cross_cutting_gaps: The initial test review found boolean-only rejects; the parent has since added branch-specific message checks. Unchanged sanitized snapshots should still be checked for storage/authorization rejects, rather than assuming every false result implies no mutation.
Use disposable isolated directories for Administrator->role0, duplicate-name and cross-target ambiguity cases; never mutate original reference or production data.

Explicitly test data-directory traversal/non-absolute/foreign tag/schema files, missing session and roles supplied directly to worker slots; identify safe defensive differences separately from source business rules.

QTEST_MAIN with no function arguments runs write then read in the same process. The revised readExperiment explicitly rejects the writer PID, so invoke function-specific commands in separate processes.
Read-back evidence intentionally excludes credentials. Successful setSession is explicit simulation and does not validate password login/security.
The revised Probe includes process CPU percentage. Log growth and cumulative O01 results still need external runner evidence or additional measurement.

boundary_test_review.method: Independent GUIless real-worker boundaries in new SN100_BOUNDARY_DIR; no reference/production DB or credentials read

independent_implementation_static_review.scope: Source-to-implementation review only, no original reference runtime or hardware claim
reviewed_core_rules: Exact nested list filter and runtime role options; invalid Administrator Update index maps through selectedRole to0.
Four double-click username writes including readOnly update target; no automatic target-role selection.
Running-state equality comparison, target password, empty new password, original missing target-rank/duplicate-new-name checks, isdefault retention.
Parameterized SQL/BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions; per-operation sessionID/DB role refresh; no pwd in AccountRow/signals.
Commit success clears requested-operation secrets; update/current-delete clears explicit session; UI waits for sanitized reload before completing acknowledgement.
Absolute/tag/canonical-reference/symlink/schema protections and no reseeding existing authentication DB.
intentional_differences_to_record: Original repeatedly connects double-click once per visible row per refresh; new UI uses one connection with the same four-field effect.
Original Guest table is hidden before clear; new UI clears old table rows before hiding, preventing stale hidden view data.
Explicit anonymous test session replaces original login/main/device globals; session switches/logout clear transient password edits and never invoke device-linked login.
Original successful message precedes logout; worker now clears session immediately on committed update/current-delete, then UI reloads and shows success acknowledgement.

New worker validates roles against available combo options to reject forged direct-slot requests, re-reads current role under transaction, rejects invalid/no active session; these defend the isolated worker boundary rather than add a target-rank rule.
Queries use parameters/transaction/bounded lock wait and distinguish storage errors from missing target; input NUL/32767 upper bound guards match representable line-edit inputs.
Original user_role physical table is not imported; fixed public0..5 role names preserve source enum/runtime combo contract for this anonymous slice; user_powers remains outside scope.

Final CusMessageBox extraction restores original480x208 contents, semantic PNGs and280ms OutCubic/opacity/-50px mask animation. Static review confirms six content widget geometries and17 source/target resource SHA pairs; final runtime screenshots/regression remain pending elsewhere.

Dialog overlay changes from whole desktop/screen center to current host window/local center and follows host moves/resizes. Parent WindowModal replaces global stay-on-top; Material close button becomes QPushButton with same geometry/icon but no ripple; relative resources become QRC and message text is PlainText.
